title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3, 2026.2.4 stored XSS was possible on the built-in web server via Markdown…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.4. The vulnerability occurs on the built-in web server through the Markdown preview feature, potentially allowing an attacker to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of the affected application.
